A three-legged '''walker''' that was well over a dozen [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall was utilized by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Walkers saw use in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on the occupied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], as well as in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. Two of the walker's multi-jointed legs were located on one side of the walker, and the body of the walker featured weaponry on both the front and back sides, both of which had viewports, so that its pilots could defend the vehicle from both directions.

After the [[Battle of Ilum]], these walkers were largely replaced by the two-legged [[Imperial Walker]]s by the time of the [[Revanite crisis]].
